primary.analysis_resampling: area-averaged linear brightness over square pixels

primary_filter.method: Camera sampling first; common aliased reciprocal-lattice notches; DC retained
order: incoherent sources -> AG thin phase screen -> focused circular-pupil wave imaging
square detector area integration -> discrete sensor samples
DFT -> common periodic-bin mask -> inverse DFT -> 100*std/mean
primary_filter.roi_rule: 840 um = 32 detector pixels = integer multiples of every exact G period; 420 um nested ROI is a sensitivity check
primary_filter.mask_rule: Enumerate reciprocal vectors within the optical intensity bandwidth, fold modulo sensor sampling frequency, remove the union of exact DFT bins for all layouts; retain DC
primary_filter.detector: Monochrome, linear, 100% square active area; noiseless, unquantized; no Bayer/ISP
primary_filter.focus: OLED emission plane through the flat reference stack; ideal aberration-free pupil already present in the optical solver
primary_filter.metric_scope: Camera-domain stochastic contrast under the declared mask, not a visually weighted or SMS-1000 calibrated reading

references.title: IEC 62977-3-9:2023, informative Annex B and Table B.1
references.use: Frequency-domain removal of periodic display modulation; compare only identical filter designs. The exact common mask here is explicitly specified by this protocol, not mandated by IEC.

references.title: Becker (2021), 10 years of sparkle measurement, sections 3.1-3.4
references.use: Camera MTF, detector sampling, aliased periodic peaks, then Fourier masking of electronic images. The optional visual-frequency cutoff is not used for this camera-domain metric.

camera_mtf_audit.note: Finite FFT pupil discretization; the existing wave pupil already supplies diffraction. Detector sinc is applied by subsequent pixel integration, not by another lens blur.
